name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: A full-screen canvas that shoots paper confetti from the middle of whichever button is pressed. Two presets fire different bursts: a broad multicoloured one and a narrower red, orange and yellow one.
use: A success moment such as a signup, payment or completed task deserves a short, non-blocking celebration.
avoid: Busy dashboards or repeated triggers: full-screen flying paper pulls attention off the task.
a11y: Both triggers are real buttons, but the canvas has no aria-hidden and the burst is purely visual. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage holds a faint grey hint line and two small white rounded buttons, one reading a party emoji plus Confetti and one a fire emoji plus Fire. Once fired, tiny coloured rectangles and streamers scatter across the whole frame, densest at the button and thinning as they fall.
behaves: Nothing moves until a button is pressed, then paper bursts out of that button's centre with a spread and speed set per button, tumbles under gravity and fades. The two buttons differ in colour palette and spray width.
customise: Each burst takes an options object for colours, spread, starting speed and particle count; canvas size, manual start and global options are props too.
weight: moderate: A canvas particle burst for a few seconds while firing, idle the rest of the time.
